blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Because of you, I almost became a stutterer.
exercises.ru: Я ___ вас чуть заикой не остался.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: When you send a telegram, brevity is essential because you will be charged for every word.
exercises.ru: Когда вы отправляете телеграмму, очень важна лаконичность, ___ вам придётся платить за каждое слово.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Because Lee was injured, the strength of the Stars has greatly diminished.
exercises.ru: ___ того, что Ли был травмирован, сила «Старс» заметно уменьшилась.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The child died from an asthma attack because the school didn't allow him to carry his inhaler with him.
exercises.ru: Ребёнок умер от приступа астмы, ___ в школе ему не разрешали приносить с собой ингалятор.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The moon emerged from behind the clouds.
exercises.ru: Луна вынырнула ___ облаков.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He succeeded, not because he made efforts, but because he happened to be lucky.
exercises.ru: Он добился успеха не ___ он старался, а потому что ему подфартило.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The bridge gave way because of the flood.
exercises.ru: Мост подломился ___ наводнения.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I don't have a washing machine, so I go to the laundromat to wash my clothes.
exercises.ru: У меня нет стиральной машины, ___ я хожу в прачечную стирать одежду.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My parents don't like my boyfriend because of his race.
exercises.ru: Мои родители не любят моего парня ___ его расы.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Moreover it's difficult to get rubbish out for garbage day because the collection time is too early.
exercises.ru: Более того, очень трудно вынести мусор для вывоза, ___ время вывоза очень раннее.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The river overflowed because of the heavy rain.
exercises.ru: Река разлилась ___ сильных дождей.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Daniel was the only one who could read the writing on the wall, as he was the only Volapükist.
exercises.ru: Только Дэниел смог прочесть надпись на стене, ___ он был единственным волапюкистом.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: By establishing Takeshima Day, it is hoped that more Japanese people will learn about the Takeshima islands.
exercises.ru: Есть надежды, что ___ принятию Дня Такэсимы, больше японцев узнает об островах Такэсимы.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Bees are very useful animals because they produce honey, wax, and pollinate flowers.
exercises.ru: Пчелы — очень полезные животные, ___ они производят мед, воск и опыляют цветы.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Due to unforeseen circumstances, our trip to the mountains this weekend will be cancelled.
exercises.ru: ___ непредвиденных обстоятельств наша поездка в горы в этот уик-энд будет отменена.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mary invested in the stock because the financial advisor fooled her.
exercises.ru: Мария вложилась в эту ценную бумагу, ___ её финансовый консультант её одурачил.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mary was completely shell-shocked after Tom dressed her down for being late for the meeting.
exercises.ru: Мэри была совершенно потрясена, когда Том устроил ей разнос ___ опоздания на встречу.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The people at this store are very friendly, and get very many customers as a result.
exercises.ru: Люди в этом магазине очень дружелюбны, и ___ у них отбоя нет от посетителей.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The patient's lung tissue was damaged from years of working in a coal mine.
exercises.ru: Лёгочная ткань пациента была повреждена ___ того, что он много лет работал на угольной шахте.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom can't stand the hot and muggy summers here, so he heads for the mountains.
exercises.ru: Том не переносит жару и духоту здешнего лета, ___ он направляется в горы.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
